FCA launches world-first platform giving firms new insight into AI innovation
articles.summary: New resource brings together real-world examples of AI adoption across financial services, helping firms identify emerging trends and opportunities. The FCA has launched a world-first AI Spotlight Observatory that provides firms, academics and innovators with a comprehensive view of how AI is being adopted across financial services.Based on practical use cases from more than 200 organisations and spanning 150 areas of activity, the online platform highlights how firms are using AI across the industry and where trends are developing.Developed in partnership with the Centre for Finance, Technology and Entrepreneurship (CFTE) and technology partner NayaOne, the Observatory helps meet the growing demand for greater visibility of AI adoption across the sector.The resource highlights a range of AI use cases shaping financial services, from solutions designed to combat financial crime and enhance compliance processes to emerging technologies such as agentic payments and neurosymbolic AI.By wi
